title: Local roles: minimal system prompt and tool set, measured on a micro-task
lead: *Proposed.* Owner direction 2026-11-15 (relay session 8d711f67, chat: "I agree, go ahead"): measure the settings that shape a local session on a fixed micro-task, and adopt what helps. Reasoning stays on at effort low (adj 350); it is not cut or capped. The launcher's auto-compaction window is 115k (owner, same chat).
findings_note: S304 trial 3 (2026-11-14/15, S248): each claude-local session started at 23.1k-23.3k input tokens before reading anything, ran 61-96 model turns for about 30 tool calls, produced 20k-68k output tokens, and averaged 13-35 s per turn. S360's --disallowedTools cut the first turn only 12% (30.2k to 26.7k, cloud haiku measure).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Most of the 23k fixed context is Claude Code's own system prompt and tool schemas, not ork's brief. claude CLI 2.1.323 has `--system-prompt` / `--system-prompt-file` (replace the default prompt) and `--tools` (limit the built-in tools sent) (`claude --help`). `--bare` is not usable: it skips hooks, and S356's approval point is a hook. The S358 fresh-session threshold is 70k (adj 335); with compaction at 115k there is room for a larger window, and vLLM prefix caching (on) keeps the repeated prefix cheap.

Open owner questions (the implementer asks them with `adj ask` first):

- Q1 (`roles.local-system-prompt`): what replaces the default system prompt for a claude-local role? (a) *recommended*: ork's own short system prompt file (`internal/roles/prompts/local-system.md`): tool use basics, one command per call, absolute paths, terse output; the role prompt and brief stay the user message. (b) keep the default prompt and only add `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections`.
- Q2 (`roles.local-tool-set`): which tools does a local implementer get with `--tools`? (a) *recommended*: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash; read-only roles the same without Edit and Write (their progress note write stays through the S356/S361 rule). (b) keep today's set minus S360's disallowed list.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestArgsLocalWriteRoleUsesOwnPromptAndSixTools`, `TestArgsLocalReadOnlyUsesAllowlist`, `TestArgsLocalReadOnlyToolsKeepEditWriteOnlyForProgressNote`, `TestArgsLocalSystemPromptFileMustBeAbsolute`, `TestArgsCloudRoleUnchanged`: a claude-local role's args hold `--system-prompt-file` naming ork's local system prompt and `--tools` with the Q2 set; a cloud role's args do not change. `TestLocalDispatcherUsesLaunchersAndRowFlags` and `TestClaudeReadOnlyRoleArguments` check the same through the runner, including the file's content.
- `TestArgsLocalUIPassKeepsSkill`: a local UI pass keeps Skill in its tool set (S360 rule).
- `TestLocalSystemPromptIsEmbeddedAndShort`, `TestEmbeddedFilesMatchNames`: the local system prompt file is embedded, and under 2,000 characters.
- `TestFreshSessionThresholdEnvOverride`: ORK_LOCAL_FRESH_TOKENS moves the fresh-session threshold for a measurement.

sections.heading: Micro-task
sections.body:
The first failing test of S248 (`TestProjectsSetDryRunSavesNothing`) from a clean S248 worktree, with a brief that says to write that test, see it fail, and stop. Each setting runs once on claude-local qwen3.8-27b low; record first-turn input tokens, turns, output tokens, wall time, whether the test was written and seen red, and restarts.

Settings to compare (results in the slice notes, one table row each):

1. Today (S360, S361, S362, S363 live).
2. Minimal system prompt (Q1).
3. 2 plus the narrowed tool set (Q2).
4. 3 with the fresh-session threshold at 95k (an env or test override only; changing adj 335 is the owner's call after the numbers).
